verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. The no-fixed-vector hypothesis makes A = I - Q invertible, so w = A^{-1}u is well-defined and nonzero. Orthogonality yields A^{-1} + A^{-ᵀ} = I, from which u^{ᵀ}w = 1/2; substituting Qw = w - u into H = I - 2uu^{ᵀ} then gives HQw = w. All hypotheses are used, and there are no external references or prohibited justification patterns.
